title: Measures in National Mental Health and Well-Being Strategy that Are Yet to Be Rolled Out and Implementation Timelines for Them
what_it_is: Measures in National Mental Health and Well-Being Strategy that Are Yet to Be Rolled Out and Implementation Timelines for Them

sections.label: Mental health and online measures
sections.summary: A National Mental Health Helpline and Textline service will be introduced in mid-2025, with a Positive Use Guide and a study of age assurance requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For instance, a new National Mental Health Helpline and Textline service will be introduced in mid-2025 to offer psychological first aid for those facing mental distress.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our other upcoming measures include the Positive Use Guide on Technology and Social Media, which will be ready in the first half of 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI) and Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) are studying whether further requirements, such as age assurance, are needed to prevent children and youths from accessing age-inappropriate content on relevant online communication services.

sections.label: Partnering with social media companies
sections.summary: Codes of practice and regulatory frameworks for social media are developed in close partnership with social media and tech companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: As we develop our various codes of practice, as well as regulatory frameworks around various aspects of social media, we do indeed partner very closely with the social media and tech companies.

sections.label: Telemedicine services and tech platforms
sections.summary: MOH is studying use of technologies to reach persons in need, with a framework for assessing telemedicine services delivered via tech platforms.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Under the MOH, we are indeed studying this and looking to see how we can use these types of technologies to better reach out to persons in need and this is not just about mental health, but there are a whole variety of indications for telemedicine services and we have a framework for assessing the governance, the safety, the approach towards telemedicine.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And so, the social media companies or the tech companies may well be a platform through which telemedicine services are delivered, but actually, it is the service provider then that we need to work with for the assessment of those services.
